Use case: ui-mockup, style-transfer.
Create ONE polished, highly legible flat iPhone application screen for the existing Italian Biliardino app: populated GIOCATORI home. Output only the complete screen, portrait aspect 402:874, approximately 1206x2622 pixels if possible, NO device bezel, NO external presentation, NO annotations.

Reference image 1 is the SOUTH AFRICA 2010 mood board: use its confident condensed black display typography, warm ivory, sweeping yellow/green/blue/red athletic ribbon paths and distinctive foosball silhouette. It is a STYLE reference, not a layout or content source.
Reference image 2 is the current actual players home: preserve its exact functions, names, presence states and FIVE bottom tabs.

Design system: background #F8F5EB, surfaces white, ink #111111, secondary text #5C5C55, blue #0057B8, green #087F3E, yellow #FFC700, red #C62828, orange #FF7900 only when showing opposing teams. Typography should closely approximate Barlow Condensed ExtraBold for GIOCATORI and action labels, Barlow Semibold/Regular for names and utility content. Crisp flat color, no grain, no neon, no glow, no translucent glass, no arbitrary gradients. Warm athletic South Africa 2010 print graphics translated to a contemporary useful app. NOT Italia 90: no mascot, tricolour grid, segmented title.

Composition: full iPhone top safe area with 9:41, black Dynamic Island and readable black status icons on ivory. A compact, distinctive masthead with large left-aligned GIOCATORI, a small black foosball silhouette on a rod at upper right, and one beautifully shaped ribbon sweep below/behind the masthead using yellow, green, blue and a narrow red accent. Do not let illustration occupy more than about 100 logical pixels beneath status bar. Under it: small summary badges "4/6 presenti" and green check "Pronti a giocare". Then one clean ivory/white roster panel with six generous separated rows. Row content order: circular initials avatar, name with presence text beneath, working-looking iOS-style switch, three-dot overflow. Avatars are dark ink initials in neutral circles; do NOT invent photos. All six rows fully visible.
Exact rows, in this order:
A Andrea — "In ufficio", green dot or check, switch ON green.
G Giulia — "Assente", gray indicator, switch OFF gray.
L Luca — "In ufficio", switch ON green.
M Marco — "In ufficio", switch ON green.
P Paolo — "In ufficio", switch ON green.
S Sara — "Assente", switch OFF gray.
All on switches have knob RIGHT; off knobs LEFT. Names sentence case, clear and large, never condensed.
Lower right above bottom navigation: blue rounded extended add-player button with person-add icon and exact label "NUOVO". Reserve useful breathing room beneath roster; a very restrained corner ribbon may live in this space. Never add start-match CTA, history or leaderboard to home.
Bottom navigation on an opaque white surface: exactly five equal-width items, all fully visible and labels on same baseline: people icon "Giocatori" SELECTED blue with short blue indicator, football icon "Partita", history icon "Storico", podium icon "Classifica", storage icon "Dati". No Home or Altro tab. Full bottom safe area beneath labels, with black home indicator. Make safe areas, rows and tap targets plausible at iPhone size. Overall design is energetic through header artwork, controlled and exceptionally readable through roster.

Reference 2 is our newly designed GIOCATORI home: match its exact visual family, warm ivory and white panels, bold condensed black typography, sweeping yellow/green/blue ribbons with narrow red accents, simple black foosball silhouettes, clean utility type, and bottom navigation.
Typography approximates Barlow Condensed ExtraBold/Black for titles/scores, Barlow Regular/Semibold for names/utility. Background #F8F5EB, surface #FFFFFF, ink #111111, secondary #5C5C55, blue #0057B8, green #087F3E, yellow #FFC700, red #C62828. Team1 blue with white lettering; team2 #FF7900 with BLACK lettering for contrast. Crisp flat surfaces, no grain, neon, glow, glass, scanlines, ornamental gradients, random accent colors, Ciao mascot or Italian tricolour grid.

Opaque WHITE bottom navigation always contains EXACTLY FIVE equal items on the same baseline: people icon "Giocatori", football icon "Partita", history icon "Storico", podium icon "Classifica", storage icon "Dati". Selected item has blue icon/text and short blue line. No Home, Altro or alternate tabs. No external captions inside UI, no device frame, no browser, no watermark.
DELIVERABLE: one high-resolution comparison board with TWO portrait app viewports side by side, each proportioned 402:874, separated by a narrow neutral gutter. They show the UPPER and LOWER scroll positions of THE SAME complete match-setup screen, not separate steps. Both full screens must include identical header, pinned green kickoff CTA and bottom nav with Partita selected. Use a canvas around 1700x1750 so text is large and readable. No extra title/caption around the board.

Header on BOTH: "NUOVA PARTITA" in compact condensed black, restrained ribbon at upper right. No back button: this is an existing top-level tab. Keep decoration small to prioritize form density.

SHARED STATE: 2 VS 2 selected; Primo a N selected; Goal vittoria 10; Vinci con due goal di scarto switch ON. Squadra1 Andrea and Luca; Squadra2 Marco and Paolo. Rivalita available but NOT active. Kickoff enabled.

LEFT VIEW shows top of scrolling content in exactly this order:
1. "MODALITA PARTITA": two side-by-side mode controls "1 VS 1" and "2 VS 2". Second selected blue with white text/check, first white with dark text.
2. "REGOLE PUNTEGGIO": a white grouped panel, segmented "Libero" / "Primo a N" with second selected blue; row "Goal vittoria" then minus button, "10", plus button; row "Vinci con due goal di scarto" with green ON switch knob right.
3. "COMPONI LE SQUADRE": outlined buttons shuffle "CASUALI" and balance "BILANCIATE".
4. Two adjacent compact team cards: blue title "SQUADRA 1" with white text, slots "Andrea", "Luca"; orange title "SQUADRA 2" with BLACK text, slots "Marco", "Paolo". Use neutral initials in slots, no photos. Team colors decorative edges plus pale body backgrounds. All four names fully visible.
The continuation below belongs to the right view. Do not invent extra controls to fill the left.
Pinned footer immediately above nav: green football-icon "INIZIA PARTITA", then full five-item nav and safe area.

RIGHT VIEW shows a lower scroll position:
Under the same compact sticky header, the same two team cards with Andrea/Luca and Marco/Paolo at top as continuity cue.
Then a white panel with small dark flame icon and exact text "Modalita Rivalita disponibile", description "Puoi trasformare questa partita in una Rivalita dedicata tra queste due coppie.", and blue action "Attiva Rivalita". Do NOT show Rivalita attiva, score history or deactivate, because rivalry is off.
Then section "GIOCATORI PRESENTI" and four compact white list rows, each with initial circle, name and two right-hand assignment controls S1 and S2:
Andrea: S1 SELECTED blue with check, S2 unselected/disabled.
Luca: S1 SELECTED blue with check, S2 unselected/disabled.
Marco: S1 unselected/disabled, S2 SELECTED orange with dark check.
Paolo: S1 unselected/disabled, S2 SELECTED orange with dark check.
All FOUR rows fully visible, no Giulia or Sara (absent).
Same pinned green "INIZIA PARTITA", five nav items Partita selected, and safe area.
Controls should suggest 48px logical tap targets with generous legibility. Do not compress names to tiny text. This is a coherent useful form, decorated only around the header and a small corner.
